tasks.query: why does route_query return bm25 while daemon warms
tasks.expected_synthesis: route_query returns BM25 immediately when lexical evidence is decisive, so latency stays low while the semantic daemon warms.

tasks.query: why does cache_key include model version
tasks.expected_synthesis: cache_key includes the model version so cached embeddings are not reused across incompatible embedding dimensions after a model switch.

tasks.query: why does retryDelay cap retries and add jitter
tasks.expected_synthesis: retryDelay caps attempts and adds jitter so workers do not retry at the same instant after a shared transient failure.
